caption: The drawing depicts a lidded tankard rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on a plain, off-white background. The main object is a large, tapered cylindrical tankard with a domed, tiered lid that has a decorative finial shaped like a pinecone on top. There are two horizontal raised bands circling the body, and the tankard stands on a thick, rounded base. The front of the tankard is adorned with an ornate monogram set within a flourished, scrolling cartouche design. Above and to the left, there is an inset drawing showing a side profile of the tankard, including a large handle with a thumb lift and an angular lower attachment. To the right, another inset shows a rear view, highlighting the hinge mechanism of the lid and a shaped terminal at the handle’s base. The drawing uses fine, precise lines and shading to emphasize the metallic nature and three-dimensionality of the tankard. The overall composition centers the primary, frontal view, with the two smaller side and rear insets symmetrically placed in the top corners.
title: Silver Tankard
